cim: Morocco explores cooperation with Oracle on cloud computing and artificial intelligence

cim_eredeti: Morocco explores cooperation with Oracle on cloud computing and artificial intelligence
szoveg_eredeti:
Morocco’s Ministry of Artificial Intelligence, Digital Transformation and Administrative Reform has held discussions with Oracle on potential cooperation in cloud computing, artificial intelligence (AI) and research and development (R&D) as the country seeks to accelerate the digital transformation of public administration and strengthen its digital capabilities.

The discussions took place during a meeting in Rabat between Minister of Artificial Intelligence, Digital Transformation and Administrative Reform, Ahmed Rahhou, and an Oracle delegation led by Andres Garcia, Vice-President of Cloud Africa.

The meeting focused on prospects for cooperation in cloud computing, AI and R&D, as well as the opportunities these technologies offer to accelerate the digital transformation of government administrations, support innovation and strengthen Morocco’s digital capabilities.

According to the ministry, the engagement forms part of its efforts to develop a high-performing and competitive digital ecosystem.

The ministry also highlighted the importance of dialogue with international technology companies in promoting the sharing of expertise, exploring new partnership opportunities and contributing to the modernisation of public services.

The discussions reflect Morocco’s continued engagement with international technology players as it explores opportunities to leverage emerging technologies to improve public administration, strengthen innovation and advance the Kingdom’s digital transformation.
